analysis.environment_evidence_protocol: ENVIRONMENT_IDENTITY_EVIDENCE_PROTOCOL defines composite scoring, pass_threshold=0.98, and reference_bank recall rules; collection plan binds batch execution order without generating records in this phase.
analysis.environment_dataset: ENVIRONMENT_IDENTITY_EVIDENCE_DATASET provides easy/medium/hard/stress batch seeds; collection plan adds identity_break_batch for boundary classification cases.
analysis.environment_reference_bank: Four bank entries supply reference_bank_id and retrieval_signature templates per evidence record; no raster anchors populated.
analysis.environment_similarity_rules: environment_similarity_v1 same_environment_threshold=0.98 governs environment_classification assignment in record spec.

evidence_collection_contract.scope: Collection execution definition only — Collection Ready != Collection Executed.
evidence_collection_contract.gpu_execution: false — collection plan and record spec only; no evidence records generated.
evidence_collection_contract.assessment_note: Evidence Records Generated = 0; do NOT claim ENVIRONMENT_EVIDENCE_COLLECTED.

collection_batch_plan.batch_note: Sequential collection order; identity_break_batch runs last for classification boundary audit.

collection_traceability_rules.record_traceability: Each evidence record must bind environment_id, reference_bank_id, retrieval_signature, and traceability_score.
collection_traceability_rules.batch_audit_signature: Collection batch_id hashes case_id list for offline replay without GPU execution.
collection_traceability_rules.classification_audit: environment_classification and classification_reason required on every record at collection time.
collection_traceability_rules.cross_ref_integrity: reference_bank_id must resolve to bank spec; mismatch rejects record at validation.
